1	import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
2	import { useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
3	import type { AuthSnapshot } from "../../../shared/ipc";
4	import { AccountCard } from "./account-card";
5	
6	export function AppShell() {
7	  const [auth, setAuth] = useState<AuthSnapshot>(
8	    () => window.lightfastBridge.auth.snapshot
9	  );
10	  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
11	
12	  useEffect(() => {
13	    return window.lightfastBridge.auth.onChanged(setAuth);
14	  }, []);
15	
16	  useEffect(() => {
17	    const unsub = queryClient.getQueryCache().subscribe((event) => {
18	      if (event.type !== "updated") return;
19	      const err = event.query.state.error;
20	      if (!err) return;
21	      const code = (err as { data?: { code?: string } }).data?.code;
22	      if (code === "UNAUTHORIZED") {
23	        void window.lightfastBridge.auth.signOut();
24	      }
25	    });
26	    return unsub;
27	  }, [queryClient]);
28	
29	  if (!auth.isSignedIn) {
30	    return (
31	      <div className="auth-gate">
32	        <button
33	          type="button"
34	          onClick={() => void window.lightfastBridge.auth.signIn()}
35	        >
36	          Sign in with Lightfast
37	        </button>
38	      </div>
39	    );
40	  }
41	
42	  return (
43	    <div>
44	      <AccountCard />
45	      <button
46	        type="button"
47	        onClick={() => void window.lightfastBridge.auth.signOut()}
48	      >
49	        Sign out
50	      </button>
51	    </div>
52	  );
53	}
54

362	  display: grid;
363	  grid-template-columns: 220px 1fr;
364	  height: 100%;
365	  min-height: 0;
366	}
367	
368	.settings-nav {
369	  display: flex;
370	  flex-direction: column;
371	  gap: 2px;
372	  padding: calc(var(--spacing) * 4);
373	  overflow-y: auto;
374	  border-right: 1px solid var(--color-border);
375	}
376	
377	.settings-nav__item {
378	  -webkit-app-region: no-drag;
379	  padding: calc(var(--spacing) * 1.5) calc(var(--spacing) * 2.5);
380	  font: inherit;
381	  font-size: var(--text-sm);
382	  text-align: left;
383	  color: var(--color-text-foreground-secondary);
384	  appearance: none;
385	  cursor: default;
386	  background: transparent;
387	  border: 0;
388	  border-radius: 6px;
389	}
390	
391	.settings-nav__item:hover {
392	  background: var(--color-background-button-tertiary-hover);
393	}
394	
395	.settings-nav__item.active {
396	  color: var(--color-text-foreground);
397	  background: var(--color-background-button-tertiary-active);
398	}
399	
400	.settings-content {
401	  padding: calc(var(--spacing) * 6) calc(var(--spacing) * 8);
402	  overflow-y: auto;
403	}
404	
405	.settings-section {
406	  max-width: 640px;
407	  margin: 0 auto calc(var(--spacing) * 8);
408	}
409	
410	.settings-section__header {
411	  margin-bottom: calc(var(--spacing) * 4);
412	}
413	
414	.settings-section__title {
415	  font-size: calc(var(--text-base) * 1.25);
416	  font-weight: 600;
417	  color: var(--color-text-foreground);
418	}
419	
420	.settings-section__subtitle {
421	  margin-top: calc(var(--spacing) * 1);
422	  font-size: var(--text-sm);
423	  line-height: 1.5;
424	  color: var(--color-text-foreground-tertiary);
425	}
426	
427	.settings-card {
428	  display: flex;

430	  overflow: hidden;
431	  background: var(--color-background-elevated-secondary);
432	  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
433	  border-radius: 8px;
434	}
435

442	  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-border-light);
443	}
444	
445	.settings-row:last-child {
446	  border-bottom: 0;
447	}
448	
449	.settings-row__label {
450	  font-size: var(--text-sm);
451	  color: var(--color-text-foreground);
452	}
453

455	  padding: 2px calc(var(--spacing) * 1.5);
456	  font-family: "SF Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace;
457	  font-size: 0.82rem;
458	  color: var(--color-text-foreground-secondary);
459	  background: var(--color-background-elevated-primary-opaque);
460	  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
461	  border-radius: 4px;
462	}
463	
464	.switch {
465	  position: relative;
466	  display: inline-flex;
467	  align-items: center;
468	  width: 30px;
469	  height: 18px;
470	  cursor: default;
471	}
472	
473	.switch input {
474	  position: absolute;
475	  inset: 0;
476	  margin: 0;
477	  cursor: inherit;
478	  opacity: 0;
479	}
480	
481	.switch__track {
482	  position: relative;
483	  width: 100%;
484	  height: 100%;
485	  background: var(--color-background-elevated-primary-opaque);
486	  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
487	  border-radius: 999px;
488	  transition: background 120ms ease;
489	}
490	
491	.switch__track::after {
492	  position: absolute;
493	  top: 1px;
494	  left: 1px;
495	  width: 14px;
496	  height: 14px;
497	  content: "";
498	  background: var(--color-text-foreground);
499	  border-radius: 50%;
500	  transition: transform 140ms ease;
501	}
502	
503	.switch input:checked + .switch__track {
504	  background: var(--color-accent);

506	}
507	
508	.switch input:checked + .switch__track::after {

512	.switch input:disabled + .switch__track {

1	import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
2	import { useTRPC } from "@repo/app-trpc/react";
3	
4	export function AccountCard() {
5	  const trpc = useTRPC();
6	  const query = useQuery(trpc.account.get.queryOptions());
7	
8	  if (query.isLoading) return <p>Loading account…</p>;
9	  if (query.error) return <p>Error: {query.error.message}</p>;
10	  if (!query.data) return null;
11	
12	  const user = query.data;
13	  return (
14	    <div className="account-card">
15	      <h1>{user.fullName ?? "Unknown"}</h1>
16	      <p>{user.primaryEmailAddress ?? ""}</p>
17	    </div>
18	  );
19	}
20
